title: Custom free-flight state at Mars
summary: A vehicle initialised directly in a 300 x 2000 km Mars orbit (state defined relative to Mars, converted to the inertial frame), with a 50 m/s prograde burn at periapsis passage.
expected_behaviour: Telemetry is reported relative to Mars; periapsis stays near 300 km and apoapsis rises after the burn.
acceptance_checks: Initial periapsis and apoapsis altitudes reproduce the inputs within 1 km.
Inclination stays at 30 degrees within 0.01 degrees.
Central body in telemetry is Mars throughout.
